title: SaaS / app feature launch with stylised UI
summary: A polished app window built in code tilts into 3D; a perspective camera glides between its chart, toggles and notifications while numbered feature callouts appear beside them and a cursor hovers and clicks with ripples, ending on the product name and a clicked call-to-action button. The interface is an abstract mock, never the real product.
techniques: Canvas 2D UI drawn from skeleton bars
CSS 3D perspective camera on a canvas layer
projected screen-space callouts and curved leaders
gallery_share: Launch videos with a floating, tilted product UI, feature callouts and a clicking cursor are among the most common model-made product videos.
limits: The UI is a generic dashboard mock (skeleton bars, a chart, toggles, a toast); it cannot show a real product's screens, and features pair loosely with those three elements.
One to three features; each needs at least 1.8 s, and about 4.7 s to read a full headline and line.
Render cost is higher than flat scenes (a large UI plane re-rasterised every frame and composited in 3D).
One typeface (Inter or the system sans); Latin scripts set best.
